summary:
[  edit  ]
The Ableton  Link   CHOP  retrieves timing information from an Ableton  Link  supported network.
For more information see:   http://www.ableton.com/en/link/
The full support of the Ableton Live system is  TDAbleton , a group of components that give you access to Ableton Songs, Tracks, Chains, Parameters and MIDI.
Ableton's  Link  FAQ is very helpful for issues on the Ableton end:  https://help.ableton.com/hc/en-us/articles/209776125-Link-FAQs .
One common problem is that Ableton  Link  doesn't work with all sound drivers, including DirectX. The free application  ASIO4All  is an easy replacement that acts as a virtual ASIO device.
See also  Ableton .

parameters.label: Active
parameters.name: active
parameters.description: Turns the  CHOP 's output on or off.

parameters.label: Enable
parameters.name: enable
parameters.description: Initializes the connection to the Ableton  Link  session.

parameters.label: Start Stop Sync Enable
parameters.name: startstopsync
parameters.description: Enables start stop synchronization for the entire Ableton  Link  session. Start stop synchronization allows for sharing of start or stop signals between subgroups of peers in a  Link  session.

parameters.label: Signature
parameters.name: signature
parameters.description: ⊞  - Specifies the time signature. The first number is the number of beats per measure and the second number indicates the type of note that constitutes one beat. See  Time Signature - Wikipedia  for additional information.

parameters.label: Callbacks  DAT
parameters.name: callbacks
parameters.description: Path  to a  DAT  containing callbacks for each event received.

parameters.label: Status Channels
parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Enables the following status channels

parameters.label: numpeers
parameters.description: number of Ableton  Link  enabled devices or app found on the network.

parameters.label: linked
parameters.description: if the Ableton  Link   CHOP  is connected to the  Link  network.

parameters.label: waiting
parameters.description: if the Ableton  Link   CHOP  is in a waiting state and not synced.

parameters.label: synced
parameters.description: if the Ableton  Link   CHOP  has synced with the  Link  network.

parameters.label: Ramp
parameters.name: ramp
parameters.description: Outputs a 0-1 ramp each bar.

parameters.label: Pulse
parameters.name: pulse
parameters.description: Outputs a pulse each bar.

parameters.label: Sine
parameters.name: sine
parameters.description: Outputs a sine wave each bar.

parameters.label: Count
parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Increases the count each bar.

parameters.label: Count+Ramp
parameters.name: countramp
parameters.description: A ramp that counts up until the bar is reset.

parameters.label: Bar
parameters.name: bar
parameters.description: Output the current bar.

parameters.label: Beat
parameters.name: beat
parameters.description: Output the current beat.

parameters.label: Sixteenths
parameters.name: sixteenths
parameters.description: Output the current sixteenths.

parameters.label: Ramp Bar
parameters.name: rampbar
parameters.description: Outputs a 0-1 ramp each bar.

parameters.label: Ramp Beat
parameters.name: rampbeat
parameters.description: Outputs a 0-1 ramp each beat.

parameters.label: Tempo
parameters.name: tempo
parameters.description: Outputs the current tempo (also known as BPM).

parameters.label: Beats
parameters.name: beats
parameters.description: Outputs the total number of beats.

parameters.label: Phase
parameters.name: phase
parameters.description: Outputs the current phase in the bar.

parameters.label: Time Slice
parameters.name: timeslice
parameters.description: Turning this on forces the channels to be " Time Sliced ".  A  Time Slice  is the time between the last cook frame and the current cook frame.

parameters.label: Scope
parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: To determine which channels get affected, some CHOPs use a  Scope  string on the Common page. See  Pattern Matching .

parameters.label: Sample Rate  Match
parameters.name: srselect
parameters.description: ⊞  - Handle cases where multiple input CHOPs' sample rates are different. When Resampling occurs, the curves are interpolated according to the Interpolation Method Option, or "Linear" if the Interpolate Options are not available.

parameters.label: Resample At First Input's Rate
parameters.name: first
parameters.description: Use rate of first input to resample others.

parameters.label: Resample At Maximum Rate
parameters.name: max
parameters.description: Resample to the highest sample rate.

parameters.label: Resample At Minimum Rate
parameters.name: min
parameters.description: Resample to the lowest sample rate.

parameters.label: Error If Rates Differ
parameters.name: err
parameters.description: Doesn't accept conflicting sample rates.

parameters.label: Export  Method
parameters.name: exportmethod
parameters.description: ⊞  - This will determine how to connect the  CHOP  channel to the parameter. Refer to the  Export  article for more information.

parameters.label: DAT  Table by Index
parameters.name: datindex
parameters.description: Uses the docked  DAT  table and references the channel via the index of the channel in the  CHOP .

parameters.label: DAT  Table by Name
parameters.name: datname
parameters.description: Uses the docked  DAT  table and references the channel via the name of the channel in the  CHOP .

parameters.label: Channel Name is  Path : Parameter
parameters.name: autoname
parameters.description: The channel is the full destination of where to export to, such has  geo1/transform1:tx .

parameters.label: Export   Root
parameters.name: autoexportroot
parameters.description: This path points to the root node where all of the paths that exporting by  Channel Name is  Path : Parameter   are relative to.

parameters.label: Export  Table
parameters.name: exporttable
parameters.description: The  DAT  used to hold the export information when using the  DAT  Table  Export  Methods (See above).

parameters.label: Rename from
parameters.name: commonrenamefrom
parameters.description: The channel pattern to rename. See  Pattern Matching .

parameters.label: Rename to
parameters.name: commonrenameto
parameters.description: The replacement pattern for the names. The default parameters do not rename the channels. See  Pattern Replacement .

parameters.label: Channel Names:  c[1
parameters.description: 10:2] ambient

parameters.label: Rename To:  b[1
parameters.description: 5] amb    This example fetches channels  c1 c3 c5 c7 c9  and  ambient .

parameters.label: start
parameters.description: Start of the  CHOP  interval in samples.

parameters.label: length
parameters.description: Number of samples in the  CHOP .

parameters.label: sample_rate
parameters.description: The samplerate of the channels in frames per second.

parameters.label: num_channels
parameters.description: Number of channels in the  CHOP .

parameters.label: time_slice
parameters.description: 1 if  CHOP  is  Time Slice  enabled, 0 otherwise.

parameters.label: export_sernum
parameters.description: A count of how often the export connections have been updated.

parameters.label: total_cooks
parameters.description: Number of times the operator has cooked since the process started.

parameters.label: cook_time
parameters.description: Duration of the last cook in milliseconds.

parameters.label: cook_frame
parameters.description: Frame number when this operator was last cooked relative to the component timeline.

parameters.label: cook_abs_frame
parameters.description: Frame number when this operator was last cooked relative to the absolute time.

parameters.label: cook_start_time
parameters.description: Time in milliseconds at which the operator started cooking in the frame it was cooked.

parameters.label: cook_end_time
parameters.description: Time in milliseconds at which the operator finished cooking in the frame it was cooked.

parameters.label: cooked_this_frame
parameters.description: 1 if operator was cooked this frame.

parameters.label: warnings
parameters.description: Number of warnings in this operator if any.

parameters.label: errors
parameters.description: Number of errors in this operator if any.

parameters.label: An  Operator Family  that manipulates text strings: multi
parameters.description: line text or tables. Multi-line text is often a python  Script  or  GLSL  Shader, but can be any multi-line text.  Tables  are rows and columns of cells, each containing a text string.

parameters.label: To "pulse" a parameter is to send it a signal from (1) an  exported  CHOP channel or (2) a python command or (3) a mouse click that causes a new action to occur immediately. A pulse via python is via the  .pulse()  function on a pulse
parameters.description: type parameter, such as Reset parameter in a  Speed CHOP . A pulse from a CHOP is typically a 0 to 1 to 0 signal in an exported channel.

parameters.label: samples
parameters.description: per-second of a  CHOP . Each CHOP in your network has a sample rate. In contrast, the overall timeline has a  Frame Rate , which is the number of frames to  cook  and display per second, generally your monitor display frequency, default 60.

parameters.label: TouchDesigner is a hierarchy of components. "root" is the top
parameters.description: most network in the hierarchy. The  Network Path  or Path for root is simply  / . A typical path is  /project1/moviein1 .
